selection.selection_reason: no intervention passed the preregistered paired-seed acceptance gate; reverted to baseline
selection.acceptance_criterion: paired mean primary delta >= 0.002 and positive paired delta on all three seeds
selection.replication_plan: If an arm is numerically promising but fails the gate, repeat only that arm and baseline on three new paired seeds before promotion.
selection.expected_mechanism: Strong regularization and rapid decay should delay late-epoch degradation, while ranking loss and recency weighting interact with DCN-lite representation learning.
selection.failure_mode: All paired component and package effects remain below 0.002 or change sign across seeds, providing attribution but no promotable gain.

split.validation_used_for: half-epoch checkpoint selection and preregistered six-arm comparison

compute_budget.design: six controlled arms by three paired seeds
